title: Twist – Flavors 60ml
description:
Twist – Flavors 60ml
Ever since the get-go, Twist E-Liquids have been kicking major goals across the world. It all starts with the acclaimed Pink Punch Lemonade and Strawberry Crush Lemonade and many more.
If you’ve got a taste for American juices, Twist is a one-stop flavour shop for you and all yours!
Twist E-Liquids are available at 0MG Nicotine Level. Twist delivers premium-quality vape juices and should not be missed if you love fruit flavoured e-liquids.
LEMON TWIST
Golden Coast Lemon Bar
The perfect balance of the tangy sweetness of lemon curds, with the smooth and rich flavor of the shortbread crust.
Peach Blossom Lemonade
A sweet, crisp mix of ripe peach slices and lemonade.
Pink Punch Lemonade
A thirst-quenching pink lemonade flavor; almost as good as pink lemonade from a lemonade stand!
Crimson No.1(Strawberry Crush Lemonade)
Fresh squeezed lemonade combined with sweet muddled strawberries to provide the perfect vaping experience.
Wild Watermelon Lemonade
Refreshing watermelon infused lemonade, perfect for the summertime!
Iced Pink Punch
The award winning Pink Punch Lemonade flavor with a cool breeze added to it.
FRUIT TWIST
Tropical Pucker Punch
A refreshing and delicious secret blend of exotic fruits.
BERRY TWIST
Berry Medley Lemonade
A delicious blend of mixed berries combined together with tangy lemonade.
MELON TWIST
Chilled Melon Remix
Sweet melon and cool honeydew flavor with a blast of icy menthol.
Honeydew Melon Chew
Sweet melon and cool honeydew flavor.
Red No. 1(Watermelon Madness)
Savory summertime watermelon vape that will make your taste buds go nuts.
COOKIE TWIST
Banana Oatmeal Cookie
A blend of warm, fresh baked oatmeal cookies for a delicious mix of deep nutty flavor topped with a sweet banana sprinkle
Frosted Sugar Cookie
A light and airy, almost cake-like confection, topped with warm vanilla frosting and sprinkles!
Strawberry Honey Graham
With its beautiful deep red design, this delicious concoction features strawberry jam, slathered over flavorful graham crackers, and drizzled with honey.
HONEY TWIST
Golden Honey Bomb
An enchanting flavor bomb straight from the honeycomb, then feel a light splash of creamy milk on the exhale that will lavish your palette with a refined flavor.
APPLE TWIST
Crisp Apple Smash
Smashed together a magnificent blend of apples to really juice things up! Appreciate a ripe, squeezed red apple that will make you excited to the core.
MANGO TWIST
Mango Cream Dream
A beautiful mixture of tasty mangoes and rich smooth vanilla to create a decadent mixture of fruit and delectable cream for an inspiring combination that will delight the taste buds in any tank or rebuildable.
